prospective_split.component_key: Minimum alias SHA256 in the component.
prospective_split.grouping: Connected components share any root, child or reported-PV FEN alias across eligible records.
prospective_split.validation_rule: int(SHA256(hash_input_ascii),16) modulo5 equals0; all others train.

root_clock_policy: Source supplies FEN4 only; root FEN6 uses halfmove0/fullmove1, children preserve the resulting legal move counter.
